data.title: BAföG Approval Notice (Bescheid über Ausbildungsförderung)
data.summary: The Studierendenwerk Mustertor (Amt für Ausbildungsförderung) approved Laura Beispielwinkel's BAföG student funding for the period April 2025 to March 2026, paying €734.00 per month, split equally between a grant and an interest-free state loan.
data.explanation: The Studierendenwerk Mustertor, your BAföG office, has approved your application for student financial aid for April 2025 to March 2026. You will receive €734.00 each month, half as a non-repayable grant and half as an interest-free loan, paid at the end of each month for the following month. You must immediately report any change in your income, address, or course of study, as these can affect your funding. If you disagree with any part of this decision, you may file a written objection (Widerspruch) with the Studierendenwerk; the app shows the deadline for this. Otherwise, no further action is needed - the payments will simply continue.

items.title: Receive monthly BAföG payment
items.action: No action needed; the funding is paid automatically into your account

date.text: jeweils zum Monatsende für den folgenden Monat

items.quote: Die Zahlung erfolgt jeweils zum Monatsende für den folgenden Monat.

items.title: Report changes immediately
items.action: Immediately tell the Studierendenwerk about any change in your income, address, or course of study
items.quote: Teilen Sie uns Änderungen bei Ihrem Einkommen, Ihrer Wohnung oder Ihrem Studium bitte sofort mit.

items.title: Deadline to file an objection (Widerspruch)
items.action: Decide whether to file a written objection (Widerspruch) with the Studierendenwerk Mustertor if you disagree with this decision
items.consequence: The decision becomes final if you do not object by the deadline shown

date.text: innerhalb eines Monats nach ihrer Bekanntgabe

items.quote: legen Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach ihrer Bekanntgabe Widerspruch beim Studierendenwerk Mustertor, Mensaweg 2, 35392 Mustertor, ein – schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.
